P1.variant: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Good Morning — arms crossed at chest
P1.effort_load: Bodyweight only; easy 2/10 effort, 3s hips back and 1s stand. Comfortable owned range, no stretch target.
P1.notes: This counted position rehearsal uses the same hip action as S1. One set; inter-set rest is not applicable. Observe the first listed repetition, with no extra assessment rep.

P2.variant: Slow Grounded Landing-Position Squat — declared bodyweight teaching adaptation
P2.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy 2/10 and at least 5 good reps in reserve; 3 s lower into a comfortable partial athletic position, 2 s hold, 1 s stand, 2 s reset. Feet remain grounded; arms reach comfortably forward for balance.
P2.notes: One complete counted opportunity per set. The action/hold/reset phases total 8 s; this is a logistics envelope, not slowed flight or a forced cadence. Count faults and an attempted jump that does not leave the ground; actual successful flight and contacts remain observations. No replacement attempt.

E1.variant: First Bilateral Flight and Hold — proposed in-place teaching variation
E1.effort_load: Bodyweight; one small, gentle vertical takeoff at easy teaching intent about 2–3/10. Use a shallow continuous countermovement and small natural arm swing from beside the trunk. No minimum height, distance score, box, drop, repeated bounce or maximal intent.
E1.notes: One complete counted opportunity per set. The action/hold/reset phases total 8 s; this is a logistics envelope, not slowed flight or a forced cadence. Count faults and an attempted jump that does not leave the ground; actual successful flight and contacts remain observations. No replacement attempt.

S1.variant: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Good Morning — arms crossed at chest
S1.effort_load: Bodyweight only, 3 s hips back / 1 s stand, soft knees, comfortable owned range, at least 5 good reps in reserve. One small taught set where history is unknown; do not claim an invented previous dose.
S1.notes: One set only. Prior two sets are deliberately reduced; a more recent one-set or smaller-repetition record is not overwritten. If handling or execution is unsuitable, count the partial action and end the set; do not add a replacement trial/set.

E1.variant: Progressive Build and Upright Rhythm Run — modest nonmaximal intent context
E1.effort_load: Bodyweight. From still comfortable standing, build smoothly over0–10m from about2/10 toward4/10, then keep relaxed purposeful4/10 through10–20m. Slow gradually through20–35m. This is a provisional coaching effort cue, not a speed percentage, required pace or maximal/flying sprint.
E1.notes: Each set is one whole counted attempt including any fault. Active/exit estimate25s; separate outside walking return40s. These are logistics estimates, not forced cadence. All25s active phases are planning allowances, not segment targets; earlier clearance leaves quiet time. The full40s outside return includes turning/rejoining. Longer actual action/return delays later releases; omit uncompleted later work instead of forcing pace. Record actual effort, slowing and faults; no extra trial.

P1.variant: Unloaded Chest-Start Reach and Return — stationary bilateral teaching task

E0.variant: Unloaded Chest-Start Reach and Return — stationary bilateral teaching task

rest.after_set: Use the row transition and next demonstration. Waiting waves add no repetitions. Extra required rest uses visible contingency, then an explicit reduction/revision.

complete_dose.prerequisite: Comfortable action, clear personal bay and ability to stop on cue.
complete_dose.count_definition: Time determines the dose; no repetition or contact count is predetermined.

count_reconciliation.calculation: Time dose; reps_total remains null.
count_reconciliation.partial_cycle_rule: A fraction in conversion arithmetic is not an accepted partial repetition. Record completed whole cycles/actions/sequences actually performed.

contact_accounting.landing_event_unit: One landing event after flight; bilateral landing is one event involving two feet.
contact_accounting.foot_contact_unit: One foot contacting the surface; bilateral landing contributes two foot contacts.
contact_accounting.task_contact_scope: Where numeric, excludes ordinary walking returns; it does not mean all task contacts follow flight. Other ordinary step/support counts remain in the per-side/segment detail or actual log.
contact_accounting.unknown_count_rule: Null means not predetermined or not a total-contact prescription; never coerce it to zero. A zero flight count does not mean zero standing/support/step contacts.

state_rules: Updates occur only in explicitly hypothetical performed events; never from attendance, a plan or a missing day.
Compatible Strength recency is task-specific. P1/P2 control observations and static knee holds do not overwrite dynamic squat dose/load.
OR07 performed unloaded hip set updates hip; a first DB set is not familiar10s handling; later days cannot restore older DBs over newer unloaded work.
One successful/emerging task does not create repeatability, familiar setup, both-direction/cue competency or main entry.
A present lower L or compressed count/intent/support packet persists in D/standard until an independently justified decision; mode itself changes no evidence.
limits: Nine declared carry-ins and deterministic route-selection policies bound the claim; most possible two-week histories and joint daily alternatives are not enumerated.
Full-week ranges are across actual selected hypothetical histories and booking/mode assignments; per-metric endpoints need not occur on the same path.
Daily clocks remain conditional on actual facility, separate return paths, staging, coach sightlines and individually fitting fixed implements/cradles. No arbitrary OR10 load swap fits by assumption.
No numeric threshold establishes between-day recovery; actual response, outside sport, repeated preparation/grip/support work and unresolved tumbling can require reduction/deferment.
